text_block_list.text: I came to a shrine with Gold Ship today, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew... Heave-ho! Heave-ho!
Up we go! Heeeave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Can't you tell just by looking? I'm dancing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dancing has always been the standard way
to communicate with the gods since time immemorial, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "When the God-beloved, shrine maiden-esque Golshi-chan dances, the divine oracle will bounce right out..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Speak of the devil, here it comes hopping!
Hop, hop, hop, hoooop!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, that's my specialty!
Alright, let's put it into practice right away!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"After all, when God gives ya His seal of approval,
ya can't just back out, can ya!"

Afterward, Gold Ship put into practice
what she was told, and her condition
improved dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~...!
'Listen to what your Trainer says'~?!
choice_data_list: If God says so, there's no helping it.
If God says so, there's no helping it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta be kidding me!
The Great Golshi-sama doesn't take orders from anyone!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Even if that happens to be God Himself!
See ya!

Perhaps because the divine revelation was ignored,
there was no sign of any condition improving whatsoever...
